title: purple-mimi: a libpurple (Pidgin) protocol plugin for MIMI via mimid
description: Mark 2026-11-21. A libpurple protocol plugin so Pidgin (and other libpurple clients: Finch, bitlbee, Spectrum2) can use MIMI rooms through mimid. Context: client-survey.md (XMPP front end mimid-wmdj also serves Pidgin via its XMPP plugin; IRC v2 mimid-i0id already works with Pidgin's IRC plugin). Note: the CBOR live stream (docs/design/binary-live-stream.md) is agent<->provider, not a local client protocol; the agent's local protocols today are JMAP Chat and IRC. The plugin's protocol is decided in step 2.
